environment.A: Computer Use native Hifly page; capability not yet verified
environment.B: formal authenticated workbench and Cloud Executor; candidate not deployed

readiness_calibrations.note: Historical first calibration; not a future quote or spending authority. Settings were not yet frozen at that observation.
Only the picture-avatar component was observed. No upload/job/generation/video download. Cleanup login confirmation may have navigated after the window; see session.

cache_policy: Input bytes may be cached with exact version validation. Each sample independently creates its own paid handheld image; no paid intermediate reuse within or across A/B. Do not clear carryover state manually between items to hide failures.

delivery_policy.uniform_processing: aspect-preserving padding; no crop or stretch; same rule for A and B; measure and retain original and mismatch evidence
delivery_policy.pre_paid_ratio_policy: Record requested target and genuine observed/unproven/uncontrolled fields; no advance assertion of not-yet-generated original dimensions; all other paid safety and attribution checks retained
delivery_policy.historical_contract_policy: Do not silently change persisted contracts or tasks

stop_rules: technical failure stops phase; ordinary visual imperfection is recorded without redo

acceptance.technical: Exact task/result attribution; correct input versions; downloadable playable original with decodable audio and metadata
acceptance.content: Recognizable correct person/product; no visible major identity/shape/color contradiction; full intended copy and selected voice; assess subtitle obstruction and lip sync by listening/viewing
acceptance.deliverable: Owner acceptance recorded separately from technical completion; unreadable fine print is not invented as a required observation
acceptance.limitations: Three pairs are exploratory; P3 changes product and avatar so cannot isolate avatar causality; queue variance and stochastic quality do not establish path superiority

record_format.unknown: null with explanation; never zero for missing measurements
record_format.privacy: Relative refs and aliases only; no credentials, signed URLs, private media or raw provider payloads. Reuse established material fingerprints; no new ordinary-field hashes.
